body:
Made the (bad) decision to try this new chemical last year, also my first experience with a strong stimulant (being from the most dangerous class in my opinion), because of pure curiosity. (bad idea)
Started slow with 1 medium size line (snorted) and in about 10 mins I started feeling a euphoric sensation and a strong jittery, unstable feeling in all of my body.
I started feeling a euphoric sensation and a strong jittery, unstable feeling in all of my body.
My hunger and thirst disappeared completly and any set of problems was gone from my head, pure bliss and "well being".
Started watching tik tok and reels at a very fast pace, without actually stopping to watch any video lol. Couldn t see anything on my screen, it was kind of a blur and some black stains on my vision. After about 30 mins the comedown started and I had a very strong urge to redose, my head was saying no,my hands were saying yes.
Redosed with 4 small lines, back 2 back. The same activity as before started, doomscrolling.
Repeated this process for about 6 hours and after I've run out of substance the worst feeling of impending doom happened.
Voices in my head, flu feelings, light fever and tremors and in about 1 hour I was back to normal like nothing ever happened.
I'm not planning on trying this ever again, simply not worth it, stopped feeling good after the second redose, the comedown and the bad unknown effects on the body and mind are not worth it.
[Reported Dose: ''0.4 grams'']
